description: Items that have been in a stage longer than expected, longest first, with how long they have waited and who owns them.

'use client' import { BlockReady, BlockStateProvider, type BlockStatus, getBlockState, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/block-state' import { PipelineAge, type PipelineItem, PipelineOwner, type PipelineStage, formatAge, getDaysInStage, isStuck, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/pipeline' import { DataTable, DataTableBody, DataTableCell, DataTableHead, DataTableHeader, DataTableRow, DataTableStateRows, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/table' import { IconPlaceholder } from '@/registry/icons/icon-placeholder' interface Pipeline3Props { /** Defaults to a sentence counting the stuck items and naming the one waiting longest. */ description?: string /** Leave out, or pass none, to show the empty state. */ items?: PipelineItem[] noun?: string now: Date stages: PipelineStage[] status?: BlockStatus title: string } const NOW = Date.UTC(2026, 8, 25, 14, 30) const daysAgo = (days: number) => new Date(NOW - days * 86_400_000) const exampleProps: Pipeline3Props = { items: [ { enteredStageAt: daysAgo(2), id: 'c1', owner: 'Priya Nair', ownerAvatar: '/images/avatar-02.webp', stage: 'screen', subtitle: 'Senior frontend engineer', title: 'Daniel Okafor', }, { enteredStageAt: daysAgo(9), id: 'c2', owner: 'Priya Nair', ownerAvatar: '/images/avatar-02.webp', stage: 'screen', subtitle: 'Product designer', title: 'Sofia Lindqvist', }, { enteredStageAt: daysAgo(4), id: 'c3', owner: 'Tom Becker', ownerAvatar: '/images/avatar-07.webp', stage: 'interview', subtitle: 'Data engineer', title: 'Ravi Menon', }, { enteredStageAt: daysAgo(15), id: 'c4', owner: 'Tom Becker', ownerAvatar: '/images/avatar-07.webp', stage: 'interview', subtitle: 'Senior frontend engineer', title: 'Hannah Cole', }, { enteredStageAt: daysAgo(11), id: 'c5', owner: 'Grace Kim', ownerAvatar: '/images/avatar-04.webp', stage: 'interview', subtitle: 'Engineering manager', title: 'Marco Bianchi', }, { enteredStageAt: daysAgo(6), id: 'c6', owner: 'Grace Kim', ownerAvatar: '/images/avatar-04.webp', stage: 'feedback', subtitle: 'Product designer', title: 'Amara Diallo', }, { enteredStageAt: daysAgo(1), id: 'c7', owner: 'Tom Becker', ownerAvatar: '/images/avatar-07.webp', stage: 'feedback', subtitle: 'Data engineer', title: 'Leo Martins', }, { enteredStageAt: daysAgo(8), id: 'c8', owner: 'Priya Nair', ownerAvatar: '/images/avatar-02.webp', stage: 'offer', subtitle: 'Support lead', title: 'Nora Haddad', }, { enteredStageAt: daysAgo(3), id: 'c9', owner: 'Grace Kim', ownerAvatar: '/images/avatar-04.webp', stage: 'offer', subtitle: 'Senior frontend engineer', title: 'Ethan Brooks', }, ], noun: 'candidates', now: new Date(NOW), stages: [ { expectedDays: 5, id: 'screen', label: 'Phone screen' }, { expectedDays: 10, id: 'interview', label: 'Interviews' }, { expectedDays: 3, id: 'feedback', label: 'Feedback' }, { expectedDays: 5, id: 'offer', label: 'Offer out' }, ], title: 'Stuck candidates', } const Pipeline3 = (props: Pipeline3Props) => { const { items = [], noun = 'items', now, stages, status, title } = props const state = getBlockState(status, items) const stageById = new Map(stages.map((stage) => [stage.id, stage])) const stuck = items .map((item) => { const stage = stageById.get(item.stage) const days = getDaysInStage(item.enteredStageAt, now) return { days, item, stage } }) .filter(({ days, stage }) => stage && isStuck(days, stage.expectedDays)) .sort( (a, b) => b.days / (b.stage?.expectedDays || 1) - a.days / (a.stage?.expectedDays || 1), ) const longest = stuck[0] const { description = longest ? `${stuck.length} of ${items.length} ${noun} past their stage’s time limit; ${longest.item.title} is ${formatAge(longest.days - (longest.stage?.expectedDays ?? 0), 'long')} over.` : `All ${items.length} ${noun} are within their stage’s time limit.`, } = props return (

{title}

{description}
{!state && stuck.length === 0 ? (

Nothing is stuck.

) : ( Name Stage In stage Over by Owner {!state && stuck.map(({ days, item, stage }) => { const expected = stage?.expectedDays ?? 0 return ( {item.title} {item.subtitle && ( {item.subtitle} )} {stage?.label} of {expected}d {formatAge(days - expected, 'long')} ) })} )}
) } export { Pipeline3, exampleProps as pipeline3ExampleProps, type Pipeline3Props }
